transcript.text:
Hello, this is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your overdue credit card payment. I’d like to remind you that your account has an outstanding balance, and a late fee of ₹1,500 has been applied. Non-payment will negatively affect your credit score and may lead to legal action.

Can you please let me know when you will be able to make the payment? If you’re facing any difficulty, I am here to help and discuss possible solutions.
Haan haan theek hai. But, could you please tell me again, what exactly is this minimum due? I am not very clear about it.

Of course, I’d be happy to explain.

The “minimum due” is the smallest amount you need to pay on your credit card bill to keep your account in good standing for the month. It usually includes a portion of your outstanding balance, interest charges (at around 12%), and any late fees (₹1,500 in your case).

Paying just the minimum will help you avoid immediate penalties, but interest will continue to be charged on the remaining unpaid balance. Paying more than the minimum will help you save on interest and clear your dues faster.

Would you like to know your exact minimum due amount today?
Haan haan theek hai, I got it. Can you tell me the amount again slowly, please? It’s hard for me to hear properly.

Absolutely, I understand.

Your total minimum due amount is ₹7,850.  
This includes your outstanding balance, interest charges, and the late fee of ₹1,500.

Would you like me to break down the exact components for you, or do you need any help with making the payment?
Haan haan theek hai. But, umm, can you say that amount one more time? I want to be sure.

Certainly. The minimum due amount on your credit card is ₹7,850.  

Would you like me to guide you through the payment process or help you with any other questions?
Haan haan theek hai. Can I pay this on any day next week? Like, can I pay on Wednesday?

Yes, you can pay on Wednesday next week. However, please keep in mind that until the payment is made, interest will continue to accrue, and your credit score may be affected due to the overdue status.

Just to confirm, shall I note your payment commitment for Wednesday? Would you like to pay the full amount of ₹7,850, or do you need any assistance with a possible discount or payment plan?
Haan haan theek hai, Wednesday it is. I will pay the full amount. Thank you.
